title: Closing-down sale
instructions: Bir mağaza kapanış indirimini duyuruyor. İndirim oranlarını ve tarihleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Attention, shoppers! After twenty years, Brown's Department Store is closing on the thirtieth of June.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Everything in the store is now thirty percent off.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: On the ground floor, all shoes and bags are fifty percent off.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Electronics on the second floor are only ten percent off.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please remember: you can't return or change anything you buy in the sale.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: From Monday, the store will open one hour earlier, at eight o'clock.

questions.feedback: Mağaza 30 haziranda (thirtieth of June) kapanıyor. Yirmi, kaç yıldır açık olduğu.
questions.evidence: is closing on the thirtieth of June.

questions.feedback: Mağazadaki her şey yüzde otuz indirimli.
questions.evidence: Everything in the store is now thirty percent off.

questions.prompt: Which things have the biggest discount?
questions.feedback: Ayakkabı ve çantalar yüzde elli indirimli.
questions.evidence: all shoes and bags are fifty percent off.

questions.feedback: İndirimde alınan ürünler iade edilemez ya da değiştirilemez.
questions.evidence: you can't return or change anything you buy in the sale.

questions.prompt: What time will the store open from Monday?
questions.feedback: Pazartesiden itibaren bir saat erken, sekizde açılacak.
